subject: AcuTrack pilot: combined credit + discount approval request (DEAL-9843)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@actrack.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Sep 2029 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits?

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're ready to move forward with a 6-week pilot, but procurement ran into a surprise legal review that will push our start date by ~3 weeks. The evaluation needs a little more quota because our data scientists plan to run end-to-end workflows, not just short prompts; estimate ~1.2M tokens over the pilot.

Two asks: can Redwood (1) extend the pilot window by three weeks and (2) provide an additional $6k in free credits to cover the extra token usage? Procurement also asked if there is any pricing flexibility for a committed 6-month license if the pilot goes well.

Samir

Date: Thu, 19 Sep 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits?

Team — forwarding AcuTrack's ask. TL;DR: procurement delay requires a 3-week push and they're requesting $6k additional credits. They estimate ~1.2M tokens extra for full-workflow validation. The opportunity looks strategic (healthcare IoT signal processing; likely to convert to a 6–12 month committed plan).

Numbers: current pilot credit commitment = $10k, proposed add = $6k (total $16k). Their ARR potential (internal intel) pegged at $180k ARR within 12 months if we get through procurement.

Requesting exec signoff for: 1) 3-week pilot extension (no change to start/end outside extended window) 2) $6k supplemental credits 3) 10% discount on first 6 months if they commit within 30 days of pilot close.

I've attached the updated mutual action plan and a short usage projection. Ben — can you confirm technical feasibility (token burn and caching recommendations)? Rishi — I need a quick cost run to confirm unit economics. Marissa — can we get approval to offer the credits + conditional discount?

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments: AcuTrack_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, usage-projection-sep2029.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Sep 2029 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits?

Naomi / Rishi — quick tech note: 1. 1.2M extra tokens is reasonable for a 6-week cadence if they use batch scoring and our KV prefix caching. 2. Recommend enabling adaptive batching and set max_seq to 1024 for their workflows. 3. If they switch to quantized Llama-2 13B variant we can lower per-token cost ~30% with negligible perf regression for their use case.

Operational impact: small; we can accommodate the extra quota on hosted fleet, no dedicated capacity changes required. I flagged a ramp window in infra to watch for token spikes.

I'll support the pilot onboarding and run reduced-cost config for the test.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Sep 2029 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits?

Naomi — quick finance perspective: incremental cost to Redwood for $6k credits (hosted) estimated at ~$1,800 (gross unit cost after batching and caching assumptions). If we pair with a 10% discount for first 6 months on an expected $45k TCV for the first half year, the net impact in the worst case is manageable and this looks like a reasonable customer acquisition investment.

Condition: discount must be conditional on a signed 6-month commitment within 30 days of pilot close. Also recommend a clawback clause: if they don't commit, we convert extra credits into a one-time post-pilot billable at standard rates.

Rishi
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
rishi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Sep 2029 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — pilot extension + credits?

Naomi — approved with conditions below.

Decision: Approve 3-week pilot extension + $6,000 in supplemental credits. Approve conditional 10% discount on first 6 months if AcuTrack signs a 6-month term within 30 days of pilot close.

Conditions: 1) Add clawback clause to MSA: unused credits expire 30 days after pilot or convert to invoiceable usage at standard rates. 2) Discount only applies to base compute charges (not professional services or support). 3) Legal to run the updated MSA change; procurement must sign the updated MAP and commitment. 4) Naomi to attach a clear success criteria doc outlining objectives and acceptance tests (must be shared before pilot restart).

Please make the MAP updates and loop legal. Naomi — execute and confirm when signed so finance can reflect in the quarter-end forecast.

Marissa Cole
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
